required_input_schema.crossover_criterion: Observable and threshold that uniquely define L_c at finite size.
required_input_schema.finite_size_fit_protocol: Gamma grid, size grid, fit window, uncertainty model, and sensitivity analysis.

acceptance_boundary: Extract L_c from independent finite-size trajectories and fit log L_c against gamma^(-1/2) only after every indispensable convention is frozen.
